verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Sentry shipping its own MCP *server* (sentry-mcp) so external AI assistants like Claude Code/Cursor can call Sentry's tools — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether Sentry can consume/plug in other MCP servers so its own AI features (e.g., Seer) can use their tools. No evidence shows Sentry acting as an MCP client or importing external MCP servers.
